_comment: Add the 'mcpServers' block below into Claude Desktop's claude_desktop_config.json (or Claude Code's MCP config). Replace <VPS_IP_OR_HOST> with the VPS address and <YOUR_MCP_API_KEY> with the value from mcp/.env on the VPS (same key on both ends). The 'tools' array below is reference documentation only -- the real MCP client discovers tools live via the protocol's tools/list call, it does not read this file's tool list.

tools.name: get_historical_bars
tools.description: Fetch OHLCV bars from MT5 (or CSV fallback) for a pair and timeframe.

parameters.timeframe: string, one of M15 | H1 | H4

tools.name: get_bot_status
tools.description: Current bot status: MT5 balance/equity, open positions with live P&L, last 10 log lines, whether the bot process is running, today's trade count.

tools.name: get_daily_report
tools.description: Agent 5's daily report text for a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or 'today'. Only the most recent report is archived (single overwritten file) -- other dates return an explanatory error.

tools.name: get_trade_history
tools.description: All closed trades between two dates.

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.description: Quick backtest for london_breakout, ny_open_breakout, or asian_range_breakout (other registered strategies return a clear not-supported response).
